cases.name: benign baseline
cases.trace: five baseline participants are not arrivals
cases.rationale: Existing members establish a baseline, not a burst.

cases.name: benign spaced arrivals
cases.trace: joins spaced more than ten seconds apart with reconciliation heartbeats
cases.rationale: Ordinary arrivals separated beyond the rule window.

cases.name: synthetic disruptive burst
cases.trace: five distinct arrivals trigger a join burst
cases.rationale: Author-labeled disruptive entry; intent is fixture metadata, not visible to the detector.

cases.name: benign scheduled group arrival
cases.trace: five distinct arrivals trigger a join burst
cases.rationale: Same observable facts as disruptive burst, but a scheduled group arrival: a deliberate false positive.

cases.name: synthetic disruptive reentry
cases.trace: three leave return pairs trigger rapid reentry
cases.rationale: Author-labeled disruptive cycling; the rule sees only transitions.

cases.name: benign unstable reconnect loop
cases.trace: three leave return pairs trigger rapid reentry
cases.rationale: Same observable timings as disruptive cycling, but benign reconnection: a deliberate false positive.

cases.name: capture interruption suppresses burst inference
cases.trace: five distinct arrivals trigger a join burst
cases.rationale: Disruptive fixture label remains positive, but a known capture gap correctly suppresses inference, yielding a measured miss.

cases.name: burst with deterministic receipt jitter
cases.trace: five distinct arrivals trigger a join burst
cases.rationale: Alternating receipt offsets preserve order and remain well inside the ten-second window; not an independent sample.

cases.name: reentry with deterministic receipt jitter
cases.trace: three leave return pairs trigger rapid reentry
cases.rationale: Receipt jitter changes measured latency without changing the three leave-return pairs; not an independent sample.

cases.name: delayed receipt suppresses burst inference
cases.trace: five distinct arrivals trigger a join burst
cases.rationale: A seven-second receipt interval leaves intermediate coverage unknown; safe suppression yields a labeled miss.
